audit_scope: Compare inspectable Paper 4 pre-action planning records with post-action feasibility artifacts for CAM, Badger, DP158, uncertainty-robustness, and SERENIoT. This is not a validation of planning utility, scientific value, or causal action benefit.

sources_and_data.observed: Offline plan selected A1 (fresh paired SQLancer++ seeds); declared ordinal expected information gain 0.85, feasibility 0.9, cost 0.25. The artifact explicitly says these are planning assumptions and that no action-level ground truth exists.
sources_and_data.limitation: This is a DBMS plan, not a unified pre-action ranking for the five audited leads.

sources_and_data.filesystem_mtime: not independently available in this session
sources_and_data.observed: Selected next action was A1, a pin/build/metric feasibility gate, with A2 conditional on passing A1. The artifact declares hypothetical prior, sensitivity, specificity, feasibility, entropy, and information-gain values rather than measured probabilities.
sources_and_data.limitation: Internal created_at/generated_at/audited_at fields are null; the planning timestamp is therefore not fully self-contained.

sources_and_data.observed: NO-GO now for the public-data artifact ablation; conditional GO only after authorized project-linked logs, cause labels, and artifacts. No model fitting or ablation ran. The 2019 Ericsson 50% binary product-fault recall remains non-comparable to CAM multiclass accuracy.

Bounded NO-GO for the matched-CPU experiment: native Kelinci built and CPU counters were observable, but Ant/Gradle/AFL/JPF/SPF/Z3 and a common cost metric were not reproducibly assembled. No Badger-versus-Kelinci outcome ran; paid compute and persistent services were zero.

Comparison was not executable: the published GDP filter lacks a certified finite-q error enclosure, while the adaptive RDP fallback is conservative ordinary-floating-point reference code. No matched (epsilon, delta) comparison or production undercount claim is justified.

Current direct test was rejected as infeasible: no version-pinned generator/code/data, matched comparator, equal-budget protocol, model training, or efficacy outcome was available. The historical near-match was not relabeled.

Conditional GO for a new small matched-device lab test, but NO-GO for immediate public-data replay. No experiment ran because traces, attack labels, and a verified runnable artifact were unavailable. Follow-up MFAF/functionality results were not treated as false-allow/false-block security outcomes.

provenance_reconciliation: Read the planner artifacts, dependency artifacts, queue records, repository status, and filesystem mtimes.
Used queue started_at/finished_at values where present; treated report mtimes as supporting local provenance only, not as authoritative creation times.
Required an explicit pre-action rank or selected action before coding rank agreement; missing rank entries were coded non-identifiable rather than as disagreement.
method.independent_outcome_coding: Coded each post-action artifact from its decision, execution status, and blocker text without importing the planner's hypothetical likelihoods or inferring success from a proxy endpoint.
method.agreement_metric: Descriptive exact rank agreement was computed only where a lead had both an inspectable pre-action rank and a post-action coded outcome. No such complete, common ranking/outcome table exists for the five-lead set; therefore rank agreement, calibration, correlation, and expected utility are not estimable.
method.sample_unit: five lead-level feasibility actions, with no completed efficacy outcome and no independent action-level utility label

observed_outcomes.interpretation: Feasibility correctly remains unresolved by execution, but rank agreement is not identifiable.
The declared gate was exercised and failed on build/metric feasibility. This is one descriptive plan-to-gate correspondence, not utility validation.
Certification infeasibility was preserved; rank agreement is not identifiable.
Artifact/protocol absence blocked the direct test; the near-match is not an outcome label.
A feasible future design was identified, but no public-data action outcome was observed and no security benefit was inferred.

descriptive_calibration_and_rank_agreeme.reason_not_estimable: The available planning records are lead-specific and incomplete: the DBMS plan is a separate baseline, the Badger plan has no internal timestamp fields, and no inspectable pre-action rank is present for CAM, DP158, uncertainty-robustness, or SERENIoT. A one-case gate correspondence cannot support a rank statistic.

result.summary: The audited actions produced feasibility and certification decisions, not action-level scientific outcomes. Badger's prerequisite gate was directionally consistent with its own pre-action plan, but the five-lead sample has no unified timestamped ranking and no completed efficacy outcomes. Paper 4 planning utility remains unvalidated.

uncertainty: Filesystem mtimes are not authoritative provenance timestamps; several planner artifacts have null internal timestamp fields.
A feasibility no-go is an observed action outcome, but it is not evidence that the underlying scientific hypothesis is false.
The five actions are heterogeneous and were not randomized against a common action set or baseline.
Small n, missing pre-action ranks, and zero completed efficacy outcomes preclude causal utility, expected-utility, calibration, or ranking-performance claims.
Proxy observations and near-matches were excluded from direct success/failure coding when their endpoint, comparator, or provenance did not match.

next_falsifiable_action.action: Freeze a single timestamped Paper 4 plan covering the same candidate leads with explicit rank, cost, feasibility assumptions, outcome definitions, and falsification gates before any further action; then prospectively code whether each gate outcome matches the predeclared feasibility prediction.
minimum_evidence: one immutable pre-action plan with creation hash and timestamp
common candidate-action table and simple baseline
independent post-action coder and exact outcome rubric
at least several completed, endpoint-matched actions before any descriptive calibration summary
separate efficacy outcomes from setup/access/certification blockers
next_falsifiable_action.falsification_gate: If future gate outcomes cannot be linked to immutable pre-action ranks and declared likelihood assumptions, retain planning utility as non-identifiable rather than scoring it.
